replacements.Selecciona cada nivel. Cuanto más avanza: Select each level. The further you advance, the more properties of the complete product —not just the model— must have failed.
replacements.El modelo cruza una política conversacio: The model crosses a conversational policy or filter.
replacements.La salida contiene información realmente: The output contains information that is actually usable.
replacements.El sistema permite proponer una acción e: The system allows an equivalent external action to be proposed.
replacements.La acción se ejecuta y produce un efecto: The action is executed and produces a real effect.
replacements.Una respuesta no deseada no equivale aut: An undesirable response does not automatically equal harm.

replacements.Ahora importa si la salida crea una capa: Now what matters is whether the output creates an actionable capability.
replacements.La rúbrica debe comprobar utilidad real,: The rubric must test real usefulness, not just words or patterns associated with a dangerous response.
